status: MODEL EVIDENCE ONLY - NO ACCEPTANCE SET; NOT HARDWARE QUALIFICATION

U1518.units: 1 high_impedance_input variant precision (BAV199 clamp + BAT54S D_BOOT); 2-4 idle

OPA4196.model: TI OPAx196 Final 1.5 (29AUG2022), generic core for the OPAx196 family

OPA4197.model: TI OPAx197 Final 1.3 (23JUN2022), generic core; same die for OPA4197IDR (SOIC-14) and OPA4197IPWR (TSSOP-14)

oracle: pinned KiCad 10 image via scripts/kicad/run.sh, ngspice -b, set ngbehavior=ps

assumed.switch: TMUX7412F modelled as its 15 ohm R_ON bound (fact-fault-switch-t-ron-12v-single), a fixed resistor; no switch capacitance, no R_ON rise within 3 V of VDD, no overvoltage turn-off (the real switch would open at +/-15 V, so case 4 at 15 V bounds clamp stress, it is not the real fault path)

DLL.spice: IS=8e-14 N=1.5 RS=1 CJO=2p VJ=0.7 M=0.33 TT=3u BV=85 IBV=1e-9

DLED.spice: IS=5.9e-20 N=3 RS=10 CJO=20p VJ=2.5 M=0.3 TT=10n BV=5 IBV=1e-5

assumed.step_edges: case 1-3 steps have 1 us rise and fall (PULSE tr = tf = 1 us); overshoot and settling hold for that edge, not a faster one. Case 5b steps use 100 ns edges
assumed.board_run_capacitance: case 2 adds 10/30/50 pF to SENSE or BUFFER (50 pF bounds a long run)
assumed.harness_load: the off-board GH harness load on *_BUFFER (cable capacitance and the far-board input) is NOT bounded by case 2 and is not modelled
assumed.unpatched: read as no source on the jack (100 kOhm R_PD only); quiescent output and oscillation check
assumed.package: Neither TI model has package parasitics; SOIC-14 vs TSSOP-14 is not distinguished by any case

diagnostic_targets: overshoot <= 10 % and settle within 1 mV (sweep_precision.py) are diagnostic labels only, not acceptance; the 45 degree phase-margin criterion is ASSUMED (stage 1b)

conditions.case1: PULSE -5..+5 V, 1 us edges, 1 ms period, second cycle measured; 10 V-peak 20 kHz sine; source 1 kOhm or unpatched
conditions.case2: case-1 step, patched, with 10/30/50 pF on SENSE or on BUFFER
conditions.case3: follower driven by an ideal +/-5 V step (1 us edges), 499+499 ohm to jack; open/100k/10k loads; 0/100p/1n cable; metrics at jack and DRIVE
conditions.case4: jack PWL 0 -> +V (200 us) -> 0 -> -V (200 us) -> 0 for V = 12 and 15, source 1 kOhm; phase reversal = output more than 0.5 V beyond SENSE against the drive direction
conditions.case5a: OPA4196 at 0/7.2/15/30 pF and, for MC04-S5, OPA4197 at 0/7.2 pF; loop broken between SENSE (source side) and IN- (load side); Middlebrook double injection (voltage run and current run, T = (Tv Ti - 1)/(Tv + Ti + 2)) with Zs/Zl at crossover, plus the voltage-only result; DC bias MONITOR = I x 5.6 kOhm; margins are per bias point, and the worst is the worst of four bias points
conditions.case5a_control: plain unity follower (IN+ 0 V, no load) of each model, broken the same way
conditions.case5b: OPA4196 at 0/7.2/15/30 pF and, for MC04-S5, OPA4197 at 0/7.2 pF; 20 kHz sines and +/-A steps (100 ns edges, 100 us halves), A = 10 mV/100 mV/1 V/5 V; 0/7.2/15/30 pF on each of LED_A and LED_K

paper_screen.note: the paper evaluated 7.22 pF and 2x/4x (14.4 / 28.9 pF); this run uses 7.2 / 15 / 30 pF, so the 30 pF rows compare against 28.9 pF

oscillation.statement: no sustained oscillation in the 105 evaluated rows
oscillation.limit: absolute 1 mV: late-window peak-to-peak for steps and holds, residual after a 1 us moving average for sines
oscillation.not_evaluated: AC loop rows (small-signal, no transient) and 10 mV indicator sines where the bridge never leaves its dead band
